title: Coating Slides with Gelatin
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: EQ0009 Leica IPS Slide Printer Operation
RP0194 Preparation of Gelatin Slide Coating Solution
Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.

steps.title: Print slide labels
steps.instruction: Print labels on the slides (SOP EQ0009) before coating; do not print on gelatin‑coated slides to avoid scratching.

steps.title: Determine slide requirements
steps.instruction: Determine the type and number of 1×3 glass microscope slides needed and obtain a suitable slide rack and staining containers.

steps.title: Load slides onto rack
steps.instruction: Place clean, lint‑free glass microscope slides onto the appropriate slide rack, label side facing upward.

steps.title: Filter gelatin solution
steps.instruction: Insert a 15 cm fluted filter paper into a glass funnel and pour the freshly prepared ~50 °C gelatin solution through the filter into a container that fits the slide rack.

steps.title: Immerse slides in gelatin
steps.instruction: Submerge the slide rack in the gelatin solution, ensuring all slides—including the painted label—are completely covered; gently agitate to eliminate bubbles.

steps.title: Drain excess gelatin
steps.instruction: After exactly 30 seconds, lift the rack and place it on benchtop paper to allow excess solution to drip off.

steps.title: Air‑dry slides overnight
steps.instruction: Leave the rack in a dust‑ and lint‑free environment at room temperature to air‑dry overnight; optionally cover loosely with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Store dried slides
steps.instruction: When fully dry, box the slides, keep them cool and dry for up to one month, and label the box with the date, coating type, and preparer’s initials.

steps.title: Reuse gelatin solution
steps.instruction: The same gelatin solution may be used for additional racks; repeat the immersion step, adding more solution as needed to keep slides fully submerged.

steps.title: Dispose of residual gelatin
steps.instruction: Dilute any remaining gelatin solution at least 2‑fold with warm water and discard down the municipal drain.

steps.title: Clean containers and racks
steps.instruction: Rinse staining containers and racks thoroughly with hot water, then clean with water and 70 % ethanol.
